name: patience
description: Practice Notes — local-first clinical note drafting

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @patience/server" "npm run dev --workspace @patience/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @patience/server && npm run build --workspace @patience/web
